en.title: "All Beautiful" Elaborate Mechanisms and Splendid Procession: Otsu Festival Float Parade Following UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage Registration
en.summary: The Otsu Festival float procession, which was added to UNESCO's intangible cultural heritage in December of last year, took place in Otsu City on the 11th. Thirteen ornate floats decorated with elaborate mechanisms and luxurious fabrics paraded through town with musical accompaniment. The festival, associated with Tensons Shrine, has a history of approximately 400 years.

en.summary: A female death row inmate in the United States survived a lethal injection execution carried out in September in Tennessee.
